notes: Phase 3 crop preview migration: migrated crop preview to dual-canvas system (desktop sidebar + mobile bottom sheet). Key changes: (1) createCropPreviewRenderer.js now accepts multiple canvas IDs via domIds and renders to all configured canvases with visibility guard (skips hidden canvases for performance). (2) CropInteraction.js accepts canvasId as string or array, attaches/detaches listeners to all canvases, uses e.currentTarget for per-canvas coordinate math. (3) createCollageLifecycle.js passes [cropPreviewCanvas, bsCropPreviewCanvas] to createCropInteraction. (4) index.html domIds includes bsCropPreviewCanvas. (5) Fixed test runner bug: getElementById('mocha') returned null due to a DOM quirk after mocha runs — switched to querySelector('#mocha'). Also added waitForSelector('#mocha .test') for reliable test completion detection. All 8 new tests pass, all existing tests pass (0 failures across 48 test files).
